claims.claim_text: In January 2024 Reddit entered into certain data licensing arrangements with an aggregate transaction price of $203.0 million, a minimum of $66.4 million of which is expected to be recognized as revenue in 2024.
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.source_quote: In January 2024, we entered into certain data licensing arrangements... The aggregate transaction price of such arrangements totaled $203.0 million. We expect a minimum of $66.4 million of revenue to be recognized during the year ending December 31, 2024 and the remaining thereafter.

claims.claim_text: Reddit's content is a foundational part of how many of the leading large language models have been trained, and Reddit expects its data advantage to remain a key element in training future LLMs (implying AI-lab counterparties license/use Reddit data).
claims.subject: Reddit data corpus
claims.predicate: used by leading LLM developers (e.g. Alphabet/Google) for AI training
claims.source_quote: Our content is particularly important for artificial intelligence... it is a foundational part of how many of the leading large language models (LLMs) have been trained.

claims.claim_text: Reddit's revenue grew to $804.0 million in 2023 from $666.7 million in 2022, generated substantially all from advertising, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of revenue in 2022 or 2023.
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.predicate: advertising revenue with no >10% customer concentration
claims.source_quote: Our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2023 was $666.7 million and $804.0 million... No customer accounted for greater than 10% of our revenues for the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2023.

claims.claim_text: Reddit's data advantage and intellectual property are a key competitive asset, and the obligations under its Revolving Credit Facility are secured by liens on substantially all assets including intellectual property assets.
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.source_quote: We expect our data advantage and intellectual property to continue to be a key element in the training of future LLMs... The obligations under the Revolving Credit Facility are secured by liens on substantially all of our assets, including intellectual property assets.

claims.claim_text: Reddit is committed under non-cancellable third-party cloud infrastructure agreements (Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform) to spend at least $385.0 million through September 2026.
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2023, we signed addenda to extend our cloud services agreements through 2026. We are committed under these arrangements to spend at least $385.0 million through September 2026.

claims.claim_text: Reddit had an average of 73.1 million daily active uniques (DAUq) and 267.5 million weekly active uniques (WAUq) in the three months ended December 31, 2023.
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.source_quote: We had an average of 73.1 million DAUq and 267.5 million WAUq in the three months ended December 31, 2023.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023 Reddit had $1.2 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities and believes these plus its $750.0 million Revolving Credit Facility are sufficient for at least the next 12 months (no going-concern doubt).
claims.subject: Reddit, Inc.
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, we had $1.2 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities... We believe our existing cash... will be sufficient to meet our working capital and capital expenditure needs for at least the next 12 months.
